name: Pashupatinath Temple
description: One of the most sacred Hindu temples dedicated to Lord Shiva, located on the banks of the Bagmati River. A UNESCO World Heritage Site and a major pilgrimage destination. The temple complex features pagoda-style architecture, hundreds of linga shrines, and the sacred Bagmati River ghats where cremation ceremonies take place.
highlights: ["UNESCO World Heritage Site","Evening aarti on the Bagmati ghats","Only Hindus may enter the inner sanctum","Pagoda-style architecture and linga shrines"]

name: Boudhanath Stupa
description: One of the largest spherical stupas in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is a focal point of Tibetan Buddhism in Nepal, with the all-seeing eyes of Buddha painted on all four sides of the spire. Surrounded by monasteries and colorful prayer flags, it comes alive during Losar (Tibetan New Year).
highlights: ["Largest stupa in Nepal","All-seeing eyes of the Buddha","Circular walk with prayer wheels and monasteries","Atmospheric butter-lamp offerings in the evening"]

name: Swayambhunath Stupa
description: Also known as the Monkey Temple, this ancient religious complex sits atop a hill west of Kathmandu. The stupa's dome represents the entire world, with the Buddha's eyes symbolizing wisdom and compassion. Offers panoramic views of the Kathmandu Valley and is one of the oldest religious sites in Nepal.
highlights: ["Panoramic Kathmandu Valley view","365 steps climb to the top","Monkey Temple with ancient shrines","One of the oldest religious sites in Nepal"]

name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site showcasing medieval Newari architecture at its finest. The square features the 55 Window Palace, the Vatsala Temple with its sandstone pillars, the iconic Nyatapola Temple (Nepal's tallest pagoda), and numerous other temples, courtyards, and sculptures dating back to the Malla period.
highlights: ["UNESCO World Heritage Site","Nyatapola Temple - Nepal's tallest pagoda","55 Window Palace and Golden Gate","Famous juju dhau (Bhaktapur curd)"]

name: Patan Durbar Square
description: Located in the heart of Lalitpur, this UNESCO World Heritage Site is renowned for its extraordinary collection of Newari architecture, including the ancient Royal Palace, the Hiranya Varna Mahavihar (Golden Temple), and the Krishna Mandir built entirely of stone. The square is a masterpiece of traditional Nepali craftsmanship.
highlights: ["UNESCO World Heritage Site","Krishna Mandir carved from a single stone","Patan Museum of Newari art","Rich metalwork and woodcarving heritage"]

name: Lumbini Sacred Garden
description: The birthplace of Lord Buddha, Lumbini is one of the most important spiritual sites in the world. The sacred garden contains the Maya Devi Temple marking Buddha's exact birthplace, the Ashoka Pillar, and the sacred pond. The site is surrounded by monasteries built by Buddhist communities from around the world.
highlights: ["Birthplace of Gautama Buddha","Maya Devi Temple and Ashoka Pillar","International monastery zone","UNESCO World Heritage Site"]

name: Janaki Mandir
description: A magnificent Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Sita (Janaki), built in the unique Koiri style of architecture. Also known as the Nau Lakha Mandir (nine lakhs of rupees spent on construction), it is one of the largest and most beautiful temples in Nepal. The temple is a major pilgrimage site for Hindus, especially during Vivaha Panchami.
highlights: ["One of Nepal's largest temples","Unique Koiri-style Mughal-rose architecture","Vivaha Panchami wedding festival","60 rooms with colourful glass murals"]

name: Chitwan National Park
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the best wildlife conservation areas in Asia. Home to the endangered one-horned rhinoceros, Bengal tiger, Asian elephant, and over 500 species of birds. Activities include jungle safaris, canoe rides, elephant bathing, and nature walks through dense sal forests and grasslands.
highlights: ["UNESCO World Heritage Site","Wildlife safaris and canoe rides","Spot the one-horned rhinoceros and Bengal tiger","500+ bird species","Tharu cultural performances"]

name: Phewa Lake
description: The second largest lake in Nepal and the centerpiece of Pokhara. Famous for its clear waters reflecting the Annapurna and Machhapuchhre mountain ranges. Visitors can enjoy boating, watersports, and visit the Tal Barahi Temple located on an island in the lake. The lakeside area is lined with restaurants, bars, and shops.
highlights: ["Mirror reflections of Machhapuchhre","Tal Barahi Temple on an island","Boating, kayaking and paddleboarding","Lakeside dining and nightlife"]

name: Nagarkot Viewpoint
description: A popular hill station offering panoramic views of the Himalayan range including Mount Everest, Annapurna, and Langtang. Famous for its spectacular sunrise views over the Himalayas. The area features numerous resorts and hiking trails through pine forests and traditional villages.
highlights: ["Best sunrise views over the Himalayas","Views of up to 20 Himalayan peaks","Mountain biking and hiking trails","Close to Kathmandu - easy weekend spot"]

name: Bandipur Hill Town
description: A beautifully preserved hill town with classic Newari architecture, rich culture, and stunning mountain views. The main street is lined with traditional Newari houses converted into inns and cafes. Offers hiking, paragliding, and spectacular views of the Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Manaslu ranges.
highlights: ["Car-free historic Newari main street","Panoramic Annapurna, Dhaulagiri and Manaslu views","Mountain biking, hiking and paragliding","Traditional inns and cafes"]

name: Manakamana Temple
description: A sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Bhagwati, believed to grant the wishes of her devotees. Accessible via a scenic cable car ride offering stunning views of the Trishuli River valley and surrounding hills. The temple is a major pilgrimage site drawing devotees from Nepal and India.
highlights: ["Darshan at the wish-granting Goddess","Scenic cable car over the Trishuli valley","Views of Machhapuchhre and Himalchuli on clear days","Major Hindu pilgrimage site"]

name: Chandragiri Hills
description: A scenic hilltop destination offering panoramic views of the Kathmandu Valley and the Himalayan range. Accessible via Nepal's longest cable car ride. The site features a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, a giant statue, restaurants, and stunning viewpoints. Popular for sunset views and day trips from Kathmandu.
highlights: ["Nepal's longest cable car ride","Panoramic views of the Kathmandu Valley","Bhaleshwar Mahadev Shiva temple","Easy day trip from Kathmandu"]

name: Gosaikunda Lake
description: A sacred alpine lake situated at an altitude of 4,380m in the Langtang National Park. Considered holy by both Hindus and Buddhists, it is believed to be created by Lord Shiva. Surrounded by dramatic mountain scenery, the lake is a popular pilgrimage destination during the Janai Purnima festival.
highlights: ["Sacred alpine lake at 4,380 m","Janai Purnima pilgrimage","Linked to a series of glacial lakes","Dense forests and alpine meadows en route"]

name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
description: One of Nepal's most popular trekking routes, taking you through lush rhododendron forests, traditional Gurung villages, and up to the heart of the Annapurna Sanctuary at 4,130m. The trek offers close-up views of Annapurna I, Machhapuchhre, Hiunchuli, and other towering peaks. Known for its diverse landscapes and rich cultural experiences.
highlights: ["Walk into the Annapurna Sanctuary amphitheatre","Poon Hill sunrise on the classic route","Hot springs at Jhinu Danda","Teahouse trekking throughout"]

name: Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek
description: A relatively short but rewarding trek that offers arguably the best sunrise views in Nepal from Poon Hill at 3,210m. The trail winds through beautiful rhododendron forests, past traditional villages, and offers panoramic views of the entire Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Perfect for trekkers with limited time.
highlights: ["Iconic Poon Hill sunrise panorama","Perfect for first-time trekkers","Rhododendron forests and Gurung villages","Easy access from Pokhara"]

name: Everest Base Camp Trek
description: The ultimate trekking experience in Nepal, taking you to the foot of the world's highest mountain. The trail passes through the stunning Khumbu Valley, crossing high suspension bridges, passing through Sherpa villages, and offering breathtaking views of Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, and Ama Dablam. Includes an acclimatization hike to Kala Patthar.
highlights: ["Stand at the foot of the world's highest mountain","Kala Patthar sunrise over Everest","Sherpa culture in Namche Bazaar","Tengboche Monastery - largest in Khumbu"]

name: Langtang Valley Trek
description: A beautiful valley trek close to Kathmandu that offers diverse landscapes from subtropical forests to alpine meadows. Known as the Valley of Glaciers, the trail follows the Langtang River through traditional Tamang and Sherpa villages. Offers stunning views of Langtang Lirung, Kyanjin Ri, and the surrounding peaks.
highlights: ["Valley of Glaciers close to Kathmandu","Tamang and Sherpa village culture","Climb Kyanjin Ri for a high-altitude sunrise","Views of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m)"]

name: Rara Lake
description: Rara Lake, the largest lake in Nepal, sits in the pristine Rara National Park at 2,990m in the far-west Karnali region. Crystal-clear turquoise water is ringed by pine forests and snow-capped peaks. A quiet retreat offering nature walks, boating, and some of Nepal's best birdwatching, away from the crowds.
highlights: ["Largest and deepest lake in Nepal","Vivid turquoise water in every season","Crisp views of the lake from Rara Hill","Wildlife spotting including the musk deer"]

name: Muktinath Temple
description: Muktinath Temple, sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists, stands at 3,710m in the Mustang region. Hindu pilgrims come to bathe in the 108 water spouts, while the ancient temple also houses a Jwala Mai with an eternal flame fuelled by natural gas. Stunning views of the Thorong La pass and the Kali Gandaki valley surround the site.
highlights: ["108 sacred water spouts","Eternal flame of Jwala Mai","Saligram stones and 108 monasteries","One of the holiest pilgrimage sites in Nepal"]

name: Sarangkot Viewpoint
description: The classic viewpoint above Pokhara, offering one of the finest sunrise panoramas in Nepal. From Sarangkot at 1,600m you look straight out to the entire Annapurna range, Machhapuchhre, and Dhaulagiri mirrored in Phewa Lake below. Also a famous launching point for para-gliders.
highlights: ["Classic Pokhara sunrise panorama","World-class paragliding launch point","Reflections of the Annapurnas on Phewa Lake","Short drive or hike from Pokhara"]

name: Dhulikhel Viewpoint
description: A serene Newari hill town on the rim of the Kathmandu Valley. Dhulikhel is famous for its panoramic Himalayan views, traditional architecture, and walking trails through pine forests. The viewpoint offers a clear line of sight to more than 20 peaks, including Gaurishankar and Langtang.
highlights: ["Himalayan panorama from over 20 peaks","Quiet Newari hill town","Ridge walks and pine forest trails","Gateway to the Arniko Highway and Tibet border"]

name: Budhanilkantha Temple
description: Also known as the Sleeping Vishnu, this open-air temple features a grand five-metre reclining statue of Lord Vishnu floating on the cosmic serpent Shesha in a pond. It is one of the holiest Vaishnav shrines in Nepal and lies at the base of Shivapuri hill, north of Kathmandu.
highlights: ["Five-metre reclining Vishnu statue","Floating on the cosmic serpent Shesha","At the base of Shivapuri hill","One of the holiest Vaishnav shrines in Nepal"]

name: Garden of Dreams
description: A beautifully restored neo-classical garden in the heart of Kathmandu's Thamel. Built in the 1920s, the Garden of Dreams features six pavilions, ornamental ponds, and hundreds of plant species - a tranquil escape from the hectic streets just outside its walls.
highlights: ["Neo-classical garden oasis in Thamel","Six pavilions and ornamental ponds","Peaceful spot for reading or picnics","Often hosts cultural events"]

name: International Mountain Museum
description: The International Mountain Museum in Pokhara celebrates the world's great mountain ranges, with galleries covering Himalayan geology, mountaineering history, the lives of Sherpa and other mountain peoples, and an Everest room showcasing climbing artefacts and records.
highlights: ["Galleries on Himalayan geology and peoples","Everest Room with climbing artefacts","Indoor and outdoor exhibits","Educational and family-friendly"]

name: World Peace Pagoda
description: The Shanti Stupa, or World Peace Pagoda, crowns a forested hill above the eastern shore of Phewa Lake. Reached by a pleasant uphill walk, it offers unobstructed views over Pokhara and the entire Annapurna range, making it a superb sunset viewpoint.
highlights: ["Panoramic views over Pokhara and Phewa Lake","Sunset views of the Annapurna range","Pleasant forest walk to the summit","One of over 80 peace pagodas worldwide"]

name: Mardi Himal Trek
description: Mardi Himal is the hidden gem of the Annapurnas - a wild, uncrowded trail that climbs through pristine forest and alpine meadows to a dramatic ridgeline just 4,500m from Machhapuchhre. Expect close-up views of Mardi Himal, Hiunchuli, and the whole Annapurna panorama.
highlights: ["Terraces and ridge-top views of Annapurna and Machhapuchhre","Photos at the 4,500 m viewpoint","High Camp sunsets above the clouds","Uncrowded, peaceful trails"]

name: Manaslu Circuit Trek
description: The Manaslu Circuit circumnavigates the world's eighth-highest mountain through the remote Budhi Gandaki valley. Traditional Tibetan-style villages, pine and rhododendron forests, dramatic gorges, and the high Larkya La pass (5,160m) make this one of Nepal's most rewarding wilderness treks.
highlights: ["Circumnavigate the world's eighth-highest peak","Remote Tibetan-style villages and monasteries","Cross the high Larkya La pass","One of Nepal's most pristine wilderness treks"]

name: Gokyo Lakes Trek
description: The Gokyo Lakes trek heads into the Khumbu to a string of brilliant turquoise glacial lakes overlooked by dramatic snow peaks. The climb up Gokyo Ri (5,360m) rewards you with arguably the finest view in the Himalaya - a sweeping panorama from Cho Oyu to Everest.
highlights: ["Turquoise glacial lakes of the Gokyo valley","Gokyo Ri panorama - the best view in the Himalaya","Views of Cho Oyu and Everest","Cross the Ngozumpa glacier"]

name: Annapurna Circuit Trek
description: The classic Annapurna Circuit crosses the mighty Thorong La (5,416m) - the world's highest trekking pass - and descends through the rain-shadow desert of Mustang. From subtropical lowlands to windswept plateaus and apple orchards, it is Nepal's most diverse long trek.
highlights: ["Cross Thorong La - the world's highest trekking pass","Enter the rain-shadow desert of Mustang","Foothills of the Marsyangdi and Kali Gandaki valleys","Walk beside Annapurna II and timeless Gurung villages"]

name: Thamel
description: The vibrant tourist heart of Kathmandu, Thamel is a lively maze of narrow streets packed with cafes, rooftop bars, trekking gear shops, craft stores and music venues. It is the perfect base for exploring the capital and the classic starting point for every Himalayan adventure.
highlights: ["Kathmandu's buzzing tourist hub","Rooftop cafes and live music","Trekking gear and souvenir shopping","Gateway to Himalayan adventures"]

name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
description: Kathmandu Durbar Square (Hanuman Dhoka) is the historic seat of the Malla and Shah kings and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The square is framed by towering temples, the old Royal Palace with its courtyards, and the fearsome Kumari House - home of the living goddess.
highlights: ["UNESCO World Heritage Site","Kumari house - the living goddess","The towering nine-tier Kak Bhairab temple","Historic Royal Palace and courtyards"]

name: Shivapuri Day Hike
description: An easy-to-moderate day hike through the forests of Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, starting from Budhanilkantha on the northern edge of Kathmandu. The trail climbs past the Nagi Gompa monastery and a spectacular viewpoint to the 2,563m Shivapuri summit, Nepal's 'water tower' that feeds the capital.
highlights: ["Day hike from Kathmandu to a 2,563 m summit","Oak and rhododendron forests of Shivapuri National Park","Visit Nagi Gompa monastery","Kathmandu Valley views from the ridge"]

name: Island Peak
description: Island Peak (Imja Tse, 6,189 m) rises like a snow-covered island above the sea of ice that surrounds it in the Everest region. A firm favourite for first-time Himalayan climbers, the ascent involves glacier walking, a headwall scramble and a final snow ridge to a camp on the spectacular summit ridge.
highlights: ["Classic first Himalayan summit at 6,189 m","Panorama of Everest, Lhotse and Makalu","Glacier ascent with a dramatic headwall","Guided expeditions from Chhukung"]

name: Phoksundo Lake
description: Phoksundo Lake in the remote Dolpa region is Nepal's deepest lake and one of the world's highest. Its startlingly clear, turquoise-blue water is surrounded by sheer cliffs, forests and the dramatic Phoksundo waterfall. The lake sits within Shey Phoksundo National Park - Nepal's largest - and has been featured twice in National Geographic.
highlights: ["Nepal's deepest lake at 3,612 m","Vivid turquoise water below the Tso Karpo cliffs","Trek past Phoksundo Waterfall - one of Nepal's tallest","Franco-Dolpo culture and ancient Bon-po monasteries"]

name: Devi's Fall
description: Devi's Fall, also known as Patale Chhango, is a dramatic waterfall where the Pardi Khola river thunders into a deep underground gorge on Pokhara's southern edge. Best seen during and just after the monsoon, it is one of Pokhara's favourite natural sights and sits next to the Gupteshwor Cave.
highlights: ["Dramatic plunge into an underground gorge","Most powerful during the monsoon","Next to the Gupteshwor Cave","Great photo spot in Pokhara"]

name: Trishuli River Rafting
description: Raft the Trishuli river, one of Nepal's most popular white-water rivers, on a scenic drive between Kathmandu and Pokhara. With a mix of exhilarating Class 2-3 rapids and calm stretches past forests and villages on the Trisuli Bazaar, Ghale Ghar and Tiger Temple routes, it suits first-timers and families.
highlights: ["Class 2-3 rapids ideal for beginners","Scenic route between Kathmandu and Pokhara","Canyons, forests and riverside villages","Full day trips with river-side lunch"]
